message: The amount requested in the token transfer ('COST_PER_EPOCH') is credited to 'agents' without verifying the balance actually received. A fee-on-transfer or rebasing token makes the recorded credit diverge from real holdings, letting a counterparty over-credit and redirect funds; read balanceOf(address(this)) deltas instead.
Function 'kill' performs a privileged operation but lacks access control (no auth modifier or msg.sender/tx.origin check).
